objective: Test with independent code on real knots the pilot result that under two added rules (at most three fresh distinctions; a knot that cannot pay waits) a ring of an odd number of knots returns to its start every two rounds while the same finite parts come apart from it, and that a third rule (never-used fillers) makes those parts end. First discriminator: exact agreement of the live roster after two rounds with the start plus n separate parts, by an implementation written from the frozen text alone, on rings of 5 to 15 knots. Also: the canonical knot test for every knot at every round by two methods, the same under not-all-equal, and the outcome under each swap of the three added rules. Stop when every frozen prediction has a verdict.
title: The ring in balance under complete rounds: an independent replication on real knots, the knot test at every birth, both knot laws, and each added rule swapped
